up: Return all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5260811. For each molecule, provide the ChEMBL ID, molecule type (e.g., Small molecule, Antibody, etc.), maximum clinical development phase (max_phase), preferred name, and canonical SMILES string. Order the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.molecule_type, md.max_phase, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5260811' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
